question: The _______ ARISE-ANIC program is a national initiative to promote research and innovation by the Department of Space (DoS), Government of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aatmanirbhar Bharat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ministries/Organisations that issued the Aatmanirbhar Bharat ARISE-ANIC Challenge Statements are:

 
 
• Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO)
 
• Ministry of Defence
 
• Ministry of Food Processing Industries
 
• Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
 
• Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ARISE-ANIC stands for Atal Research and Innovation for Small Enterprise- Atal New India Challenge.
 
• The Aatmanirbhar Bharat ARISE-ANIC program is a national initiative under the Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) of NITI Aayog to promote research & innovation and increase the competitiveness of Indian startups and MSMEs.
 
• Objectives of the Aatmanirbhar Bharat ARISE-ANIC program is to proactively collaborate with esteemed Ministries and the associated industries to catalyze research, innovation and facilitate innovative solutions to sectoral problems. The objective is also to provide a steady stream of innovative products & solutions where the Central Government Ministries / Departments will become the potential first buyers.
 
• The Aatmanirbhar Bharat ARISE-ANIC program is in line with the Honourable Prime Minister’s mandate of Make in India, Startup India, Aatmanirbhar Bharat to fast track the growth of the Indian MSME sector.
 
• Based on the evaluation of the applicant’s proposal and the working committee’s approval, the grantee will be eligible for funding support of up to a maximum of Rs. 50 lakhs in three tranches of 30%, 40%, and 30% of the total funding amount.
 
• Basic Information about Atal Innovation Mission:
 
 
• AIM Established: Announced by Arun Jaitley in his Budget Speech 2015-16 and approved by the Cabinet on 24 February 2016.
 
• AIM key person: Shri R. Ramanan (Mission Director)
 
• Parent Organisation: NITI Aayog.
 
 
 
• Major initiatives of AIM taken in the first year of establishment:
 
 
• Atal Community Innovation Center- To stimulate community-centric innovation and ideas in the unserved /underserved regions of the country including Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.
 
• Atal Tinkering Labs: to foster curiosity, creativity, and imagination in young minds and inculcate skills such as design mindset, computational thinking, adaptive learning, physical computing, etc.
 
• Mentor India Campaign- A national Mentor network in collaboration with the public sector, corporates, and institutions, to support all the initiatives of the mission.
 
• Atal Incubation Centers-Fostering world-class startups and adding a new dimension to the incubator model.
